stance_basis: paraphrase indicating Milwaukee County Board favored construction of the Airport Spur, plus multiple formal adoptions of supporting plans
summary: The Milwaukee County Board consistently supported the Airport Spur project, formally adopting the Master Plan for General Mitchell Field expansion, adding the Airport Spur to the County Expressway System, and adopting regional transportation plans that recommended the freeway connection. Testimony at public hearings revealed the Board favored construction of the Airport Spur.
complaint_summary: The Milwaukee County Board formally adopted the Master Plan for expansion of General Mitchell Field and officially added the Airport Spur to the County Expressway System in early 1969.

statement.text:
January 21, 1969
Milwaukee County Board adopted Master Plan for expansion of General Mitchell Field's passenger and air cargo facilities.
March 11, 1969
Milwaukee County Board officially adds Airport Spur to County Expressway System.

summary_quote: Testimony revealed that the Milwaukee County Board, Milwaukee Common Council, SEWRPC, Federal Aviation Administration and the American Automobile Association favored construction of the Airport Spur.
